comments.text:
I watched him lay his guitar on the stage and bow off.

He was involved in a game of what I call echo add-on. Where you play something and the next person plays it and adds a bit.

He , Jimmie Vaughn ,Eric Clapton , Buddy Guy , and BB King were on stage playing and he started.  So , by the time it got back around to him , he had to shut it off. He can't hang with the big dogs.

I also saw the best , imo , I ever saw that day.  Jeff Beck.
comments.author: @Jeffrey-q6v
